rationale: Keep Landmark Dividend LLC as the single canonical company and do not create an InfraBridge ownership period or merge another company record. The InfraBridge repo-only judgment is an attribution overlap: current official evidence identifies Landmark as a DigitalBridge portfolio company with a 40% ADIA interest. Correct ADIA's stake and acquisition vehicle, replace the generic DigitalBridge vehicle label with the official DigitalBridge-sponsored-vehicles description, add the official website and current headquarters, correct the founding year to 2010 while preserving 2002 as the year the management team pioneered the ground-lease acquisition business, and record current verification. Landmark's February 2026 Vault transaction was an exit of a 2%-owned managed joint venture and does not change ownership of Landmark itself.
